arms.description: TG103 (7.5 mg) will be administered via subcutaneous injection once a week in subjects with type 2 diabetes.
arms.label: TG103, 7.5 mg

arms.description: TG103 (15 mg) will be administered via subcutaneous injection once a week in subjects with type 2 diabetes.
arms.label: TG103, 15 mg

arms.description: Dulaglutide will be administered via subcutaneous injection once a week in subjects with type 2 diabetes.
arms.label: Dulaglutide

interventions.description: TG103 injection, 7.5mg, 15 mg, SC, once a week
interventions.name: TG103

outcomes.measure: Changes in glycosylated hemoglobin (HbA1c) from baseline at 28 weeks of treatment
Changes in HbA1c from baseline at 52 weeks of treatment
The percentage of HbA1c≤6.5% and the percentage of HbA1c≤7% at week 28 and 52
Change in fasting plasma glucose (FPG) from baseline at week 28 and 52
Change in weight from baseline at week 28 and 52
Change in 2h-postprandial plasma glucose (2h-PPG) from baseline at week 28 and 52
Mean 7 point blood glucose curve from baseline at week 28 and 52. Change in mean postprandial blood glucose increment from baseline at week 28 and 52.
Change in blood lipids (triglycerides, total cholesterol, high-density lipoprotein cholesterol, and low-density lipoprotein cholesterol) from baseline at week 28 and 52.
Proportion of subjects receiving remedial therapy at week 28 and 52
The occurrence of TG103 anti-drug antibodies (ADA) and neutralizing antibody (NAb).

trial.brief_summary: This is a randomized, open-label, dulaglutide-controlled, multicenter Phase 3 trial to evaluate the efficacy, safety, and immunogenicity of different doses of TG103 injection in combination with metformin in subjects with type 2 diabetes with poor glycemic control treated with metformin monotherapy.
trial.brief_title: A Study of TG103 Injection Combined With Metformin in Treatment of Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
trial.official_title: A Multicenter, Randomized, Open-label, Controlled Phase 3 Trial of TG103 Injection in Combination With Metformin in Subjects With Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
